Metadata.title: FAVHA | Foundation for the Alliance of Human and Animal Life — Colombia
Metadata.description: Coexistence in Colombia: animal welfare and social support. FAVHA connects programs for people and animals with a humane, community-driven and bioregional lens.
Metadata.ogTitle: FAVHA: alliance for human and animal life in Colombia
Metadata.keywords: FAVHA, foundation, animal welfare, social support Colombia, animal protection, community health, nonprofit Colombia, human and animal life, alliances, donations

Hero.fullName: Foundation for the Alliance of Human and Animal Life
Hero.tagline: Trust, empathy and joint action for everyone who shares the same landscape.
Hero.trustLine: People and animals in one mission of care and dignity.

MissionVision.missionBody: We promote harmonious coexistence between human communities and animals through health, protection, education and local partnerships that strengthen shared wellbeing.
MissionVision.visionBody: A Colombia where human and animal life mutually recognise each other as part of the same social and ecological fabric—with public policy and civic culture aligned to responsible care.

ActionLines.sectionSubtitle: Complementary programmes for communities and animals.
ActionLines.human1Body: Workshops and outreach to strengthen safety and self-care in neighbourhoods and rural roads.
ActionLines.human2Body: Support and referral to mental health networks for families facing vulnerability.
ActionLines.human3Body: Crafts, gardens and home-based ventures that generate income with respect for the environment.
ActionLines.animal1Body: Campaigns with veterinary partners for ethical population management and animal welfare.
ActionLines.animal2Body: A foster network and a humane path towards responsible adoption.
ActionLines.animal3Body: Resources and conversations in schools and neighbourhoods to prevent abandonment.
ActionLines.animal4Body: Engagement with authorities together with broader animal protection movements.

Alliances.title: Partners and collaborators
Alliances.body: We work with organisations, veterinary clinics, schools and companies that share our values. Space reserved for partners’ logos.

CtaBand.title: Your support sustains the alliance
CtaBand.body: With a donation or volunteering, you expand our impact across Colombia.

Footer.jurisdiction: The Foundation for the Alliance of Human and Animal Life conducts its activities under the laws of the Republic of Colombia.
